blocks.text: Nodics is not simply a replacement for one named framework. It combines concerns that are often assembled from several categories:

items: a web/API framework for request handling;
application architecture conventions for services and data;
jobs, events, messaging, cache, search, import, and export;
generated contracts, tests, and AI guidance.

blocks.text: For a fair comparison, compare the complete solution needed to operate your product, not Nodics against the HTTP layer of another framework.
How To Run A Fair Proof Of Concept
Ask each candidate approach to implement the same representative scenario:

items: Create a tenant-aware business record and secured API.
Add a customer-specific rule without changing shared framework source.
Add a scheduled or event-driven process.
Replace or configure one infrastructure provider.
Generate or publish the API contract.
Test authorized, unauthorized, invalid, boundary, and tenant-isolation cases.
Explain how the application moves from one process to modular deployment.
Show how a new developer or AI tool discovers where the next change belongs.

blocks.text: Measure delivery time, but also measure the amount of custom platform code, operational complexity, test evidence, customization safety, and expected maintenance cost.
